page_title: EIN 3-4 UNI | Eintracht Frankfurt v Union Berlin 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) prepares to take a corner kick.
90+7' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) was quite harsh and Sven Jablonski didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+6' Eintracht Frankfurt are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
90+3' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) replacing Derrick Kohn.
90+1' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging some short passes.
90+1' The game has come to an end for Nnamdi Collins. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
89' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Steffen Baumgart, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
88' Steffen Baumgart isn't happy on the touchline after referee Sven Jablonski shows him a yellow card.
88' This is a yellow card! Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
87' 3 - 4 Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Frederik Ronnow to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
86' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
86' It’s a PENALTY to Eintracht Frankfurt after the VAR review!
84' Referee Sven Jablonski makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Union Berlin. Let’s see what happens!
83' PENALTY APPEAL by Eintracht Frankfurt, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
81' The substitution is prepared. Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Oliver Burke.
80' 2 - 4 Goal! Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:4.
79' Eintracht Frankfurt fail to score from a corner as Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) leaps to collect the ball.
79' Kaua Santos pulls off a great save to deny Oliver Burke (Union Berlin), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
77' Sven Jablonski interrupts the game. One of the players from Union Berlin won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
76' Eintracht Frankfurt enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

74' What a sweet touch by Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him!
73' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) replaces Christopher Trimmel.
72' Substitution. Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ilyas Ansah walks off.

72' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
71' Flag goes up against Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
70' The attendance for today's match is 59500.
69' It will be a substitution. Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is ready to enter the pitch as Elye Wahi walks off.
66' Great teamplay by Eintracht Frankfurt as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
65' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
62' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.
61' Dino Toppmoller prepares a substitution. Jean-Matteo Bahoya is replaced by Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt).
61' Substitution. Fares Chaibi did his best and is replaced by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) is coming onto the pitch as Hugo Larsson cannot continue after picking up an injury.
60' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
59' Shots on target – 5:4.
56' 1 - 4 Goal! Andrej Ilic slips in Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) for a one-on-one with the keeper, and he simply dinks the ball over him into the net.
55' Referee Sven Jablonski points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) goes wild in celebration.
54' Wait! Referee Sven Jablonski has indicated he is going to review the Union Berlin goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

53' 1 - 3 It's a goal! Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) makes it 1:3. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Andrej Ilic and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Kaua Santos was helpless.

52' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
51' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
49' Sven Jablonski has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' 1 - 2 Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
45+2' Eintracht Frankfurt quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

45+1' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
43' Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
39' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
38' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
35' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) is caught offside!
34' Sven Jablonski blows for a foul after Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
32' 0 - 2 Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) finds himself one-on-one with the keeper after a great pass by Andrej Ilic. He takes the shot early and scores!
31' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
30' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
28' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Union Berlin was in an offside position.
27' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
24' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:2. The current number of shots on goal is 3:1.

20' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Frederik Ronnow anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
19' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
18' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick, but Frederik Ronnow reads it well and stops the effort.
16' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
15' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
14' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Eintracht Frankfurt comes to nothing.
12' Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough foul. Sven Jablonski stops the game and makes a call.

9' 0 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the left post. Kaua Santos just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:1.

7' A neat pass is well received by Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
6' The game is interrupted. Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
5' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) commits a rough challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
3' The match can continue after the interruption.
2' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Sven Jablonski got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
